newsitem.title: JAPAN: Naphtha prices hit five-year high in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Naphtha prices hit five-year high in Tokyo.

text.p: Naphtha prices hit a five-year high in afternoon Tokyo trade on Wednesday, the sixth consecutive day of rises, due to firmer overnight crudes, traders said.
"Today's levels are the highest since October 1991," one dealer said.
Bids for first-half December open-spec naphtha were heard at $217.50, while offers were assessed at $218.50. It was quoted at $215.50/$216.50 in late trading on Tuesday.
Trading was mostly quiet as sellers backed away, expecting prices to rise further.
